name: Akihabara UDX (UDX AKIHABARA SPACE)
accessSummary: Akihabara Station (JR) Electric Town Exit: 2 min walk / Akihabara Station (Tsukuba Express) Exit A1: 3 min walk / Akihabara Station (Hibiya Line): 4 min walk / Suehirocho Station (Ginza Line) Exit 1: 3 min walk
hours: All facilities can be used 24 hours (rental may not be available during maintenance or on building closure days). Building hours are 7:00-22:00 on weekdays and 7:00-18:00 on Sat, Sun & holidays; anyone leaving after those hours must use the after-hours route (re-entry after leaving is not possible).
notice: The facility names will change from Thursday, November 19, 2026: Akiba Square (アキバ・スクエア) becomes UDX Square Hall (UDXスクエアホール), UDX Theater (UDXシアター) becomes UDX Theater Hall (UDXシアターホール), UDX Gallery (UDXギャラリー) becomes UDX Gallery Hall (UDXギャラリーホール), and UDX Gallery NEXT (UDXギャラリーネクスト) on the 4F becomes UDX Conference (UDXカンファレンス). UDX Conference on the 6F is unchanged. The collective name of the facilities will be "UDX Hall & Conference" (UDXホール＆カンファレンス).

rooms.name: 6F UDX Conference A+B+C
rooms.note: Classroom is 2 per desk. Hollow square: 80 seats; island layout: 168 seats (28 islands of 6). A 122㎡ + B 127㎡ + C 104㎡. Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 6F UDX Conference A+B
rooms.note: Classroom is 2 per desk. Hollow square: 64 seats; island layout: 96 seats (16 islands of 6). A 122㎡ + B 127㎡. Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 6F UDX Conference D, E and F (each)
rooms.note: Classroom is 2 per desk. Hollow square: 36 seats; island layout: 36 seats (6 islands of 6). Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 6F UDX Conference Waiting Room
rooms.note: Up to 6 people. Chairs, table and clothes rack. 9:00-18:00 12,650 yen / 3 hours 4,950 yen / 5 hours 7,700 yen (tax included). Cannot be used on its own.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Event Hall L
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 102 seats; island layout: 324 seats (36 islands of 9). Chairs can be rented for up to 400 seats. Hall 560㎡ + foyer 165㎡ (price list). The L-shaped space can be divided into 2 rooms by movable walls, in 2 ways: N+S and E+W. Minimum use 5 hours.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Event Hall E
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 102 seats; island layout: 216 seats (24 islands of 9). Minimum use 5 hours. When the neighboring room is used by another party, the sound from each room may be audible in the other.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Event Hall W
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 54 seats; island layout: 81 seats (9 islands of 9). Minimum use 5 hours. When the neighboring room is used by another party, the sound from each room may be audible in the other.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Event Hall N
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 72 seats; island layout: 135 seats (15 islands of 9). Minimum use 5 hours. When the neighboring room is used by another party, the sound from each room may be audible in the other.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Event Hall S
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 90 seats; island layout: 189 seats (21 islands of 9). Minimum use 5 hours. When the neighboring room is used by another party, the sound from each room may be audible in the other.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Waiting Room 1 (for Halls L, S and W)
rooms.note: Up to 12 people. Chairs, table and clothes rack. Cannot be used on its own. If another party is using it at the same time, consult the venue.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Waiting Room 2 (for Halls L, N and E)
rooms.note: Up to 9 people (price list, as of October 2026). The venue page states a ceiling height of 2.7 m and up to 12 people. Located by the window, so it is easily affected by the outside temperature. Cannot be used on its own. If another party is using it at the same time, consult the venue.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery Cloakroom
rooms.note: A place for coats and baggage. Cannot be used on its own (Halls L, N and E page).

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery NEXT Conference NEXT1
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 72 seats; island layout: 135 seats (15 islands of 9). For ceiling height, the price list gives 3.6 m at the front and 4.0 m at the rear, while the venue page gives 4.0 m. Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery NEXT Conference NEXT2
rooms.note: Classroom is 3 per desk. Hollow square: 54 seats; island layout: 81 seats (9 islands of 9). Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Gallery NEXT Conference NEXT3
rooms.note: Classroom is 2 per desk. Hollow square: 40 seats; island layout: 54 seats (9 islands of 6). Minimum use 3 hours.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Theater
rooms.note: 172 fixed seats (movable table at every seat) plus 2 wheelchair spaces. Minimum use 5 hours.

rooms.name: 4F UDX Theater Lobby
rooms.note: With a reception counter (for reception use).

rooms.name: 4F UDX Theater Waiting Room
rooms.note: Up to 6 people.

rooms.name: 2F Akiba Square Indoor Space
rooms.note: High ceiling 7.8 m, low ceiling 3.0 m. Standing capacity is up to 800. The price list gives classroom 200-300, theater 400-600, standing buffet 700, and standing 700-800 (depending on the stage configuration and layout). The standard layout has no desks or chairs arranged (rest tables and stacking chairs are available for rent). Minimum use 8 hours.

rooms.name: 2F Akiba Square Open Space
rooms.note: Standing capacity 280. Rates are set for the full area and the half area. Minimum use 8 hours. The Akiba Square introduction describes it as an outdoor space of 280㎡ (total 1,290㎡), while the top page describes it as 260㎡ (total 1,270㎡).

rooms.name: 2F Akiba Square Waiting Room
rooms.note: Up to 15 people (classroom style). 27,500 yen (tax included), charged only when the Open Space alone is used.

rooms.name: UDX Plaza - Akiba Plaza (outdoor)
rooms.note: About 450㎡. Available hours 9:00-21:00 (amplified sound 11:00-17:00). 9:00-17:00 200,000 yen; 9:00-21:00 300,000 yen (excluding tax). Vehicles are in principle not allowed in.

rooms.name: UDX Plaza - Sabonius Plaza (outdoor)
rooms.note: About 165㎡. Available hours 9:00-21:00 (amplified sound 11:00-17:00). 9:00-17:00 200,000 yen; 9:00-21:00 300,000 yen (excluding tax). Vehicles are allowed in (size and weight limits apply, and there are no-entry areas).

ops.prevDaySetup: Preparation-day rates (9:00-20:00, tax included) are set for the Gallery: Hall L 524,700 yen, E 419,100 yen, W 157,300 yen, N 261,800 yen, S 319,000 yen. Akiba Square has setup/teardown rates: for the indoor space, on weekdays all day (9:00-22:00) 385,000 yen, morning (9:00-17:00) 277,200 yen, afternoon (13:00-22:00) 308,000 yen; on Sat, Sun & holidays all day 550,000 yen, morning 396,000 yen, afternoon 440,000 yen; for the open space, 220,000 yen all day for the full area and 110,000 yen all day for the half area (tax included). Usage time includes all setup and cleanup time, and shipping and receiving of packages is limited to within the usage time. Use outside usage hours requires a prior meeting with the person in charge. (Source: Price List as of October 2026, Terms of Use as of August 24, 2026, each venue page)
ops.loadingHours: To use the loading area, a load-in/load-out plan must be submitted in advance, and loading and unloading follow the instructions of the person in charge of each venue (security cards are lent as needed). Packages cannot be left sitting in the loading area, and the lifter and the N1, N2, S1 and S2 elevators are used to move goods to and from the venues (contact the secretariat to use N1, N2, S1 and S2; a security card is required). The maximum vehicle height that can enter the loading area is 3.4 m. Load-in/load-out items, including courier parcels, must be discussed with the organizer in advance, and instructions on time, route and protective covering must be followed. If construction work is involved, construction drawings, setup plans and electrical drawings must be submitted at least 30 days before. Building hours are 7:00-22:00 on weekdays and 7:00-18:00 on Sat, Sun & holidays. (Source: Loading/Unloading Guide October 2020, Underground Parking Map December 2024, Terms of Use as of August 24, 2026)
ops.vehicleRules: Leaving vehicles parked in the loading area is prohibited; move them as soon as the work is finished. The loading area can be crowded depending on the day of the week and time of day. Load-in on the street is prohibited unless the designated application form is submitted (the Terms of Use also prohibit roadside parking). The vehicle height limit for the 1F loading area is 3.4 m, and the entrance to the underground parking lot is 2.4 m. Using hand trucks in the office elevators and parking elevators is prohibited, as is unloading from taxis. For events at UDX Plaza, only Sabonius Plaza allows vehicles in (size and weight limits apply); Akiba Plaza does not in principle, and there is no dedicated parking for load-in and load-out vehicles. (Source: Loading/Unloading Guide October 2020, Underground Parking Map December 2024, UDX Plaza Operation Manual November 2024, Terms of Use as of August 24, 2026)
ops.parking: UDX Parking (underground) has a capacity of 800 vehicles. For use of 3,000 yen (tax included) or more per shop, 1 hour of free parking is provided (a service coupon is issued at the shop; some exceptions apply). The height limit at the entrance to the underground parking lot is 2.4 m. The official sources differ on the entry hours for hourly parking: the access guide says 6:00-22:00 (vehicles that entered before 22:00 can exit), the parking guide PDF (June 2026) says exit only from 22:00 to 5:00 the next day, and the Akihabara UDX access page says it operates 24 hours. It is 1.8 km (about 5 min) from the Honcho exit of Metropolitan Expressway Route 1 Ueno Line, and 2.6 km (about 11 min) from the Nishi-Kanda exit of Route 5 Ikebukuro Line. (Source: Akihabara UDX Access, Access section of the UDX Akihabara Space top page, UDX Parking Guide PDF, Underground Parking Map December 2024)
ops.waitingRooms: The Conference has 1 waiting room (7.7㎡, up to 6 people, chairs, table and clothes rack; 9:00-18:00 12,650 yen, 3 hours 4,950 yen, 5 hours 7,700 yen, tax included). The Gallery has 2 waiting rooms (13㎡ each; Waiting Room 1 is for Halls L, S and W, and Waiting Room 2 is for Halls L, N and E) and a cloakroom. The Theater has a 4F waiting room (7.5㎡, up to 6 people) and a lobby with a reception counter (about 60㎡). Akiba Square has a waiting room (25㎡, up to 15 people); the 27,500 yen (tax included) charge applies only when the Open Space alone is used. The Conference and Gallery waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. (Source: Price List as of October 2026, each venue page)
ops.catering: Eating and drinking is allowed inside each meeting room and hall, but bringing in food and drink is in principle prohibited (consult the organizer in advance in special circumstances), and when arranging food and drink the facility's designated vendors must be used. Eating and drinking in common areas is in principle prohibited. Box lunches, drinks, and catering for receptions and parties after the event are handled by venue staff, and partner vendors for box lunches, hors d'oeuvres and catering are listed on the official "Food & Services" page. Serving food and drink at UDX Plaza, such as with food trucks, is in principle not allowed; consult separately. (Source: FAQ, Food & Services, Terms of Use as of August 24, 2026, UDX Plaza Operation Manual November 2024)
ops.restaurants: The dining zone "AKIBA_ICHI" in the same building has been temporarily closed since January 23, 2026 for a major renovation. The official announcement says it will reopen on Thursday, December 10, 2026 as a dining zone of about 30 shops, and some shops will open early from November 17 to 27 (floor guide). Shops that remain open include Fukushimaya and Kanekoya on the 1st floor (announced December 4, 2025). For receptions, the official recommendation is catering arranged by venue staff (for receptions and parties). (Source: UDX DINING & SHOP, Floor Guide, Notice of Temporary Closure of AKIBA_ICHI, Food & Services)
